newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swisscargo to raise cargo rates.
newsitem.headline: Swisscargo to raise cargo rates.

text.p: Swisscargo Ltd said it was raising its cargo rates an average of 15 Swiss centimes per kg as of March 1.
"The management of Swisscargo (formerly Swissair Cargo) has decided to raise cargo rates as of March 1, 1997 by an average 15 centimes per kg," it said in a statement.
The first phase applies to export traffic from Switzerland to Asia and the Middle East.
"Further adjustments are foreseen in European countries," it said, citing price erosion and the dwindling of margins to almost break-even levels despite several countermeasures.
It said the timing of other adjustments was still open.
Swisscargo, a separate unit of SAirLogistics since January 1, expects 800 million Swiss francs ($568.5 million) in 1997 sales, it said.
